notes.title: Early Access Update 0.4: Manual Battles Part 0
notes.notes:
-Added initial access to manual battle features.
--A test scenario for manual battles can be accessed from the title screen.
--Currently, there is no proper UI for designating characters, spawning soldiers, etc.
--these functions are bound to keys instead.

---The following lords are available for playing and spawning:
----Karavi Champion (M/F)
----Vinsarr Knight (M/F)
----Karavi Archmaster (M/F)

---The following soldiers are available for spawning:
----Karavi Levy
----Nylleh Mage
----Vinsarr Bodyguard
----Karavi Patriot
----Karavi Bastion
----Karavi Lionsguard
----Karavi Wench
----Nylleh Shackled
----Karavi Heirsguard

-Main controls are as thus:
--Movement: WASD or Arrow keys
--Jump: Numpad 0
--Change Camera Mode: "C" Key
--Zoom/Pan Camera: "right Ctrl" Key
--Teleport to Location (DEBUG!): "P" Key
--Change Lord: Keys 1-6 (not numpad)
--Load Vinsarr Knight Data to Character (DEBUG!): "/" Key
--Spawn Lords: R, G, T, H, Y, J Keys
--Spawn Soldiers: E, F, K, L, Z, X, V, B, N, M, :, ", Ins, Home, PgUp, PgDn Keys
---(Might have missed a few, there. Have fun!)
--Primary Action: Left Click
--Secondary Action: Right Click
--Recenter Overhead Camera: Middle Click
--Toggle Automatic Allied Recuperation: - Key
--Down Self (DEBUG!) - I Key
--Recuperate Self (DEBUG!) - O Key

The AI may be a little buggy. I was testing a more advanced system before present circumstances hampered development time. I hope you enjoy, nevertheless, and I'll see you with the next update!

notes.title: Lords of the Darkreign Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
Hello Lords and Ladies!

[i][b]Lords of the Darkreign[/b][/i] is currently planned to release on July 21st. We are excited to get the game into your hands, but please keep in mind that we are a new, small developer, and thus bugs may have circumvented our testing. If you run into one such bug during gameplay, please either report it under the game discussions, or email details about it to us at [b]LOTD-Support@protonmail.com[/b]. Please provide as much information as you can about the issue so we can recreate it on our end, and hopefully get it fixed.

[i][b]Lords of the Darkreign[/b][/i] is planned to be sold for $4.99 US at the time of this release, with a 10% discount running for the first week afterwards. We feel this is a fair price for the admittedly limited scope of the game at this point, and one that will likely increase as we add more features. Speaking of more features, we have already begun development on manual-resolve for the first big early access update. Below, you can see a [i]Mixamo[/i] preview of our Karavi male base model, using some sword and shield animations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40816100/8a86b0ae4bb186f5ac63aac8a42d09d59da63c49.gif[/img]

[i](Mixamo apparently uses subsurface colors for its preview. Our boy is not supposed to be green D:)[/i]

If the model looks a little low-detailed, that's intentional. We are trying to fit as many soldiers on the battlefield as possible, to get an intense experience in gameplay, while also not sacrificing compatibility with older systems. Nevertheless, unit limits in manual battles will be a setting when this feature is introduced, so those of you with beefy computers can [strike]flex on us poors[/strike] enjoy the full experience.

That pretty much wraps up this announcement. Thank you for your time, and I hope you enjoy the game! [strike]I'll get back to fixing green boi now.[/strike]
